newsitem.title: CROATIA: Deutsche Bank opens Croatian office.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank opens Croatian office.

text.p: Leading German bank Deutsche Bank AG opened its representative office in Croatia on Tuesday, the eleventh transition country where it operates.
"Sound economic development in Croatia demands an increased presence in this country," board member Michael Endres told a news conference.
The representative office in Zagreb will serve as a springboard for contacts with all business partners and will improve the bank's better services, it said in a press release.
Endres described it as "a first step" towards forming a proper operational unit at a later stage, but mentioned no definite time frame.
Deutsche is amongst the most active financial institutions supporting trade between Croatia and Germany. It was said to be backing 30 percent of all transactions.

It participated in a syndicated loan which raised 300 million German marks for the government last year and has also been mandated to back up the development of a thermal plant Plomin II entrusted to Germany's power company RWE.

Deutsche Morgan Grenfell has been appointed to prepare two Croatian companies for privatisation -- Adriatic pipeline operator Janaf and electrical concern Koncar -- both of which also hope to float their shares abroad later this year. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
